description: Finds the top-ROI accounts on Hyperliquid's public perp leaderboard (week, month or all-time window, with a minimum account size) and reads their live open positions from Hyperliquid's public info API, then sums net long/short USD exposure per coin. Shows where the best-performing Hyperliquid traders are positioned now. Hyperliquid perps only, not spot wallets on other chains; not investment advice. Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

coin.description: Optional coin symbol to focus on, e.g. BTC

minAccountUsd.description: Minimum account value in USD for an account to count, 10000 to 100000000 (default 100000)

top.description: How many top-ROI accounts to read, 3 to 25 (default 15)

window.description: Ranking window: day, week, month or allTime (default month)

name: agent_intel_smart_money_inflow_tracker
title: Agent Intel Smart Money Inflow Tracker
